name: cockpit
description: cockpit: Claude Code mods by davidho27941. Instruments for the session: an OpenSpec and sub agent board, hand over before compacting, keep the prompt cache warm, and pre-flight checks for risky shell commands (blast-radius) and Google Cloud changes (gcloud-guard). UI in English, Traditional Chinese or Japanese.

plugins.name: opsx-board
plugins.description: OpenSpec board: current phase (propose / apply / archive), the task in tasks.md being worked on, and every sub agent's description, model/effort, tokens and progress

plugins.name: auto-handover
plugins.description: When context usage reaches your threshold, writes a handover note first, then compacts, and hands the note to the compacted conversation and to the next session in the same project

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while a session idles: one tiny request over the conversation prefix every 50 minutes (configurable) so the entry does not lapse after an hour

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations), measures what they would change, then asks you to Proceed or Cancel. Vendored from anthropics/claude-code-playground, Apache-2.0

plugins.name: gcloud-guard
plugins.description: Holds gcloud and gsutil commands that create, change or delete cloud resources, shows the account, project, location and the resource's current state, then asks you to Proceed or Cancel
